QuestInfo.name: Samurai Skirmish 2
QuestInfo.0: Motonari's plan has thrown Oda's forces into confusion! What else does he have in mind?
QuestInfo.1: Motonari wants you to keep harassing the enemy's elite warriors. This is good training, too!
QuestInfo.2: You got the enemy all mixed up. They won't be able to attack Momijigaoka for a while in their current state.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: #Wbasic#\n#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 373\nCan proceed to the Foxtail Mystery quest

0.0: My plan was a success. If I am not the next Shogun, it will only be because I am too effective. You continue your assault. I will tell you when we are done thinning their ranks.

default.0: You must break their command structure, sellsword! Go to Momijigahara 2 and hunt down 50 Oda Warriors.
